geographic_bounds._disclosure: PTF-NASHVILLE-TN-NEW-MARKET-001 discovery bounding box for the Greater Nashville traveler lodging market. The box is DELIBERATELY LARGER THAN THE MARKET. It covers the whole of Metropolitan Nashville-Davidson County (downtown, the Gulch, Music Row, Midtown, Vanderbilt/West End, Green Hills, Berry Hill, Belle Meade, the Nations, Germantown, MetroCenter, Bordeaux, East Nashville, Inglewood, Donelson, the BNA airport corridor, Music Valley/Opryland, South Nashville, Antioch, Hermitage, Old Hickory, Madison and Bellevue) PLUS every fringe area this order was told to evaluate rather than assume: Brentwood and Franklin/Cool Springs in Williamson County, Goodlettsville and Hendersonville in Sumner County, Mount Juliet and Lebanon in Wilson County, and Smyrna and La Vergne in Rutherford County. Those fringe properties are FOUND on purpose so each one is classified on evidence -- OUT_OF_MARKET_BOUNDARY_DECISION where this order's corridor registry claims no postal code -- rather than silently missed. The box deliberately stops short of Murfreesboro (35.85 N excludes it), Spring Hill and Columbia to the south, Clarksville to the northwest, Gallatin to the northeast and Cookeville to the east: those are separate Tennessee markets and several carry BNA-prefixed Marriott property codes, which is exactly why a code prefix is never allowed to decide membership here. No committed discovery box overlaps this one -- the nearest committed market, Louisville, Kentucky, begins at 37.9 N, more than 1.4 degrees of latitude north.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~2-4 decimal places) approximate municipal- and district-center reference points from general public geographic knowledge. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries and for the local OSM extract bbox only; nothing downstream treats them as survey-grade, and no census row takes its coordinates from this file.
